nodes.label: Wave mode (Vagues) progression
nodes.rationale: Minimum IV rises by 5 every five waves up to the cap of 31, and offered species progress by base stats, so difficulty scales without levels.

nodes.label: Battle data fallbacks (default accuracy 100, no PP, defense fallback 1, Lutte/Struggle)
nodes.norm_label: battle data fallbacks (default accuracy 100, no pp, defense fallback 1, lutte/struggle)
nodes.rationale: Attack JSON lacks accuracy so a configured default of 100 is used; PP are not used so moves repeat without limit; two Pokémon lack defense so the loader falls back to 1; Lutte is the fallback for a Pokémon with no valid attack.

nodes.label: Level-less combat (stats from base stats and IVs)
nodes.norm_label: level-less combat (stats from base stats and ivs)
nodes.rationale: Combat does not use levels: stats are computed directly from base stats and IVs.

nodes.label: Unsupported attack effects and attack aliases (copie, vole objet, fuite)
nodes.norm_label: unsupported attack effects and attack aliases (copie, vole objet, fuite)
nodes.rationale: Duplicate attack names with conflicting values use the first entry of ATTACK/attack_data.json; effects copie, vole objet and fuite are not simulated and are listed in data_defaults.unsupported_attack_effects; aliases are centralised in data_defaults.attack_aliases.

nodes.label: .env configuration (DATABASE_URL, FLASK_SECRET_KEY, DISCORD_CLIENT_ID/SECRET, DISCORD_REDIRECT_URI)
nodes.rationale: DATABASE_URL is the same variable as the bot's; the Discord client secret stays server-side and must never be published.

nodes.label: Production deployment behind gunicorn (WSGI)
nodes.rationale: In production run behind a real WSGI server (gunicorn app:app) rather than the Flask dev server.

nodes.label: Raw Discord IDs displayed instead of usernames
nodes.norm_label: raw discord ids displayed instead of usernames
nodes.rationale: The app cannot resolve usernames without calling the Discord API; showing real names would require a bot token server-side or storing the username at capture time.

nodes.label: Shared Postgres database with the Discord bot
nodes.norm_label: shared postgres database with the discord bot
nodes.rationale: The app only reads the bot's Postgres database, so it needs no Discord bot token; each HTTP request opens its own DB connection, so bot and web app can run side by side without interfering.
